alignment.accounting: sum of training, validation, diagnostics and failed/timeout worker durations; final test separately reported as in run2.sh
alignment.trial_limit_policy: cap 1.5 * 10800 seconds, prorate remaining shared budget before concurrent dispatch
alignment.llm_reference_difference: Original RecHarness run2.sh uses GLM-5.2; user selected local Codex gpt-6.1-sol with medium reasoning effort for these runs.
alignment.search_scope: complete training program, fixed external grading; native method controllers retained
alignment.execution_isolation: trusted local processes; test directory omitted from training environment, not an OS filesystem jail

mlevolve.implementation: native AgentSearch with CPU hybrid experience memory; common full-program executor and Codex transport

mlestar.implementation: local task adapter of official retrieval, merge, retraining ablation, block refinement and ensemble control flow

self_evolverec.implementation: four native Self_EvolveRec trajectories sharing one baseline and GPU ledger
self_evolverec.unavailable_fields: review ratings/text and item categories/ratings/prices/stores; explicitly marked unobserved, never fabricated
self_evolverec.selection: host macro validation HR@10 replaces native combined HR@5/NDCG@5; critical flag used as feedback
